## Purpose and affected file IDs
Describe the change and identify the exact ID(s) and functional area.

## Source of change
- [ ] Work was committed on a named development branch.
- [ ] Source file / original author / permissions are documented where relevant.
- [ ] Existing design references and software links were checked.

## Manufacturing and functional evidence
- [ ] Actual modified files and source inputs are included (no uncontrolled duplicate designs).
- [ ] Print-job objects and quantities were checked, if 3MF was changed.
- [ ] Physical/electrical/software tests and limitations are described below, or **Not tested** is stated.

**Tests, evidence, unresolved risks:**

## Tracking and release
- [ ] File ID and filename agree with naming rules, or exceptions are explained.
- [ ] The working Google Sheet reflects proposed names, statuses and applicable test data.
- [ ] Repository `inventory.csv` includes any approved path or filename changes.
- [ ] Cross-references, README links and operation guide changes were reviewed if affected.
- [ ] Ready for review by the designated lab maintainers; no claim of approval from GitHub checks alone.
